name: Computer Web Engineering meets then beats the relevant, independently qualified Cloudflare web capabilities
asks:
New thing: We want to fie an issue so that our living web server can optionally do this: Automatically convert HTML to Markdown for requests that use content negotiation headers (Accept: text/markdown)

This is something Cloudflare's pro plan does: we want to add a Requirement to Living Web Server to meet-then-beat the relevant parts of Cloudflare's offerings, an I suppose we should add to computer-web-systems-engineering-services-section as a requirement to meet then beat cloudflare, generally. (I don't think we currently have a "break a requirement down into subrequirements so that its fulfillment can be met in chunks, and that's definitely something we will have to do. eventually, so lets start earning toward that too.)

x-provenance.leader-phrase: computer-web-systems-engineering-services-section (no independently accessible repository at this path; the original Computer Web Engineering Services Section is the source owner)

domain-slices.admission: Explicit opt-in, RFC 9110 negotiation, authorized source fidelity, safe policy/cache and independent agent receiving; do not infer training license.

domain-slices.cloudflare: Workers request handlers and static assets
domain-slices.admission: Same authorized Fetch functionality deployed and consumed through original Node and Worker host, with safe rollback.
Variant/cache-key, invalidation, public-vs-private policy and comparable workload receiving; global PoP claim excluded.
Applicable documented threat model, origin authorization/CSRF and browser-agent abuse refusals; outside same-job performance and legal constraints.
Measurable legitimate origin routing, certificate lifecycle, failover and independently observed service correctness.

domain-slices.cloudflare: AI Crawl Control and Pay Per Crawl
domain-slices.admission: Source rights, crawler identity, policy, correct 402/charged fetch semantics, verified payment and independently accepted content, not invented x402 equivalence.
Real operator configures and safely rolls back same-job host/version/policy at measured effort, cost and disruption.

x-provenance.existing-peer-coverage: Existing Caddy/nginx/Hono living-server comparison remains source-owned at data/records/requirements-records/living-web-server-meets-then-beats-application-peers.json and is not replaced by this Cloudflare target.
x-provenance.partial-acceptance: Each met-when cell is independently evaluable; one cell holding does not assert that this broad requirement is fully met. Source-owned tests named here are demanded outputs, not claimed to exist or pass.
x-provenance.native-decomposition-gap: The current canonical requirement schema does not accept explicit parent/child keys; pending original Requirements Management https://github.com/561-group/requirements-management-team/issues/1, domain-slices is provenance-only, not a typed installed relation.
x-provenance.exclusions: No arbitrary claim of worldwide Cloudflare PoP parity, proprietary WAF algorithm recreation, entitlement to customer data or a Third Party product subscription; rights, standards and installation are separately gated.
qualification-gaps: Cloudflare applicable features, editions, host plans and actual matched workloads must be current-qualified per slice prior to claiming parity
All seven proposed native tests are unimplemented and cannot be interpreted as passed; installed real host/customer receiving is not established
The original provider/source owner, competent office, cost and user acceptance gate stay distinct from source declaration
x-provenance.status-boundary: Source-authored requirement only; no signed live requirement admission, native runtime, comparative commercial result or scheduled task is claimed.
